chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

If any man manages a large amount of wealth and has greatly engaged in usury in it without knowing that, then later comes to know it and wishes to remove that from himself, then what has already passed is for him, and he must leave it in what he begins thereafter.

key_terms.أَدَارَ: managed or circulated wealth in financial dealings
key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury or unlawful increase in financial transactions
key_terms.فَجَهِلَ: was unaware or ignorant of the matter
key_terms.مَا مَضَى: what has already passed before awareness
key_terms.مَالًا: property or wealth under a person's control
key_terms.يَسْتَأْنِفُ: what he undertakes anew in the future
key_terms.يَنْزِعَ: remove or withdraw himself from it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on wealth acquired through riba before a person knew it was usury?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who had dealings involving riba while ignorant of its presence or ruling, then later became aware. It states that what has already passed is not retroactively taken from him, but he must abandon such dealings going forward.
